name: Bretta Ironhewn
title: Master Smith
examine: Forearms like bridge cables and a burn scar older than the town bank. The anvil answers her on the first strike.
lines: Stand clear of the sparks or learn to like them.
I learned my trade at the Grand Forge, under Balla, before she was Forgemistress. Ask her who won the anvil trials. Then watch her face.
Good steel is honest. It does exactly what you made it to do, and nothing you didn't.
